{{Top|leg}}
The '''''haalas'''''<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>, or cuirass, is a portion of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protects the torso and consists of six major components:
*''[[Ghet'bur]]'' - gorget, which protects the throat<ref name="TBHC" />
*''[[Hal'cabur]]e'' - breastplates, paired between ''beskad'' and ''kal'' pieces, which protect the chest<ref name="TBHC" />
*''[[Iron Heart|Ka'rta beskar]] - tapul, also known as the Iron Heart or Mandalorian Diamond, a decorative piece which protects the heart<ref name="TBHC" />
*''[[Shar'tas]] - placard, which protects the stomach and innards<ref name="TBHC" />
*''[[Nor'cabur]]'' - backplate, which protects the back and reinforces the weight of the jetpack<ref name="TBHC" />
